tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_fixint_positive
tests.intent: Verify that positive fixint values inside a MessagePack array are correctly decoded by the scalar run reader.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_fixint_negative
tests.intent: Verify that negative fixint values inside a MessagePack array are properly processed as signed integers.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_uint_types
tests.intent: Verify uint8, uint16, uint32, and uint64 formats parsed via the contiguous scalar run loop.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_int_types
tests.intent: Verify int8, int16, int32, and int64 formats parsed through the scalar run.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_floats
tests.intent: Verify float32 and float64 values parsed inside a MessagePack scalar run loop.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_nil_booleans
tests.intent: Verify nil, false, and true head bytes processed correctly in the scalar run.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_mixed_array
tests.intent: Verify a combination of scalars followed by a non-scalar (string) handled correctly when loop terminates.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_buffer_boundary
tests.intent: Verify behavior when fewer than 9 bytes remain in the buffer, falling back to standard parsing gracefully.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_non_contiguous
tests.intent: Verify that non-contiguous inputs (like std::list) correctly route through the false_type tag bypass.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_array16
tests.intent: Verify array 16 (0xDC) prefix triggers the scalar run for contiguous buffer streams.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_array32
tests.intent: Verify array 32 (0xDD) prefix triggers the scalar run correctly.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify empty arrays (length 0) bypass the scalar run logic cleanly.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Verify nested arrays where inner arrays also trigger or don't trigger scalar runs properly.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_sax_interface
tests.intent: Verify SAX parsing interface events directly when parsing a scalar run array.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_map_inside_array
tests.intent: Verify that encountering a map inside an array halts the scalar run and delegates to general parsing.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_sax_early_abort
tests.intent: Verify that returning false from a SAX handler during a scalar run terminates parsing early.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_unsupported_head
tests.intent: Verify that an unsupported or unhandled head byte in the scalar run falls through to general parsing or throws.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_long_sequence
tests.intent: Verify a long contiguous sequence of scalars performs correctly across multiple iterations of the scalar run loop.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_exact_nine_bytes
tests.intent: Verify behavior when a message pack scalar exactly matches the minimum 9-byte bulk remaining requirement.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_binary_inside
tests.intent: Verify that a binary subtype header encountered inside an array halts the scalar run loop.
